title: COVID-19 market crash (Black Thursday)
text: Global pandemic panic triggers a cross-asset selloff; equities and oil crash and investors dash for cash. Bitcoin falls about 40% in a day as leveraged long positions on derivatives exchanges are liquidated in a cascade and exchange order books thin out.

title: China crypto warnings and May 2021 leverage flush
text: Tesla suspends bitcoin payments over energy concerns, then Chinese regulators warn financial institutions against crypto services and signal a mining crackdown. Overleveraged futures positions are liquidated as Bitcoin drops sharply intraday and exchanges suffer outages.

title: China declares all crypto transactions illegal
text: The People's Bank of China declares all cryptocurrency transactions illegal and bans overseas exchanges from serving Chinese users. A regulatory ban headline from a major economy hits prices and sentiment.

title: El Salvador legal-tender day flash crash
text: Bitcoin becomes legal tender in El Salvador; the Chivo wallet has problems and the market sells the news. A sudden flash crash liquidates leveraged longs across derivatives exchanges.

title: December 2021 weekend flash crash
text: Thin weekend liquidity and high leverage lead to a sudden flash crash; hundreds of millions in long positions are liquidated within hours amid macro worries about Fed tightening and the Omicron variant.

title: Hawkish Fed risk-off selloff
text: Expectations of faster Federal Reserve rate hikes trigger a broad risk-off selloff in technology stocks and crypto; Bitcoin breaks key support and leveraged positions are liquidated.

title: Terra UST depeg and LUNA collapse
text: The algorithmic stablecoin UST loses its dollar peg; the Luna Foundation Guard sells bitcoin reserves to defend it and LUNA hyperinflates toward zero. Contagion spreads across crypto lenders and funds exposed to Terra, and the stablecoin market is shaken.

title: Celsius pauses withdrawals; Three Arrows Capital insolvency
text: Crypto lender Celsius halts all withdrawals, swaps and transfers citing extreme market conditions. Hedge fund Three Arrows Capital faces margin calls and defaults; insolvency fears and contagion spread to other lenders such as Voyager and BlockFi.

title: Ethereum Merge completes
text: Ethereum switches from proof of work to proof of stake in a long-anticipated technical upgrade; the event passes without technical failure and is largely priced in.

title: FTX collapse
text: Reports question Alameda Research's balance sheet and its reliance on the FTT token; Binance announces it will liquidate its FTT holdings. Customers rush to withdraw, FTX halts withdrawals, a Binance rescue deal collapses and FTX files for bankruptcy. Insolvency contagion hits lenders such as BlockFi and Genesis.

title: Genesis files for bankruptcy
text: Crypto lender Genesis, a unit of Digital Currency Group, files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after FTX-related losses had frozen withdrawals; the filing was widely expected and the market barely reacts.

title: Silvergate and SVB failures; USDC depeg
text: Crypto-friendly bank Silvergate winds down and Silicon Valley Bank collapses in a bank run. Circle discloses billions of USDC reserves held at SVB and the stablecoin loses its dollar peg over a weekend before regulators guarantee deposits.

title: SEC sues Binance and Coinbase
text: The US Securities and Exchange Commission sues Binance and its founder, and the next day Coinbase, alleging unregistered securities trading. Regulatory lawsuit headlines weigh on altcoins named as securities.

title: Court ruling in SEC v. Ripple
text: A US judge rules that XRP sold on public exchanges is not in itself a security, a partial win for Ripple against the SEC; altcoins rally briefly on regulatory relief.

title: US spot Bitcoin ETFs approved
text: The SEC approves the first US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds after a fake approval post from a hacked SEC account the day before. Heavy trading follows and the price sells the news.

title: Bitcoin halving
text: The scheduled Bitcoin block reward halving cuts new supply; the long-anticipated event passes as expected.

title: Mt. Gox repayments and government bitcoin sales
text: The Mt. Gox estate begins repaying creditors in bitcoin and the German government moves and sells seized bitcoin, creating fears of supply overhang and selling pressure.

title: Yen carry-trade unwind global selloff
text: A Bank of Japan rate hike and weak US jobs data trigger an unwind of the yen carry trade; global equities plunge, the VIX spikes and crypto sees large liquidations as risk assets sell off together.

title: US presidential election
text: A pro-crypto candidate wins the US presidential election; Bitcoin rallies to new all-time highs on expectations of friendlier regulation.

title: Bybit exchange hack
text: Hackers steal about 1.5 billion dollars of ether from a Bybit cold wallet, the largest crypto exchange hack on record. The exchange stays solvent, processes withdrawals and borrows to cover the loss.

title: US tariff announcement global selloff
text: Sweeping US import tariffs announced in early April trigger a global equity selloff and volatility spike; crypto trades as a risk asset and falls with stocks before a tariff pause.

title: October 2025 liquidation cascade
text: A US tariff threat against China late on a Friday triggers a sudden crash; record leveraged positions are liquidated across derivatives exchanges in a cascade, altcoins plunge and some stablecoins briefly depeg on individual exchanges.
